targets.review_note: For fixed damage d, casts continue while each health bin((j-1)d,jd] contains at least one minion; answer is one plus the number of consecutive nonempty bins from the first. Add-only operations permit offline processing: record first insertion time per health; earliest nonempty time for each bin is a range minimum, and activation time for prefix of j bins is the maximum of those minima. Enumerate all O(n log n) bins across d with sparse-table RMQ; group equal activation times per d, then replay original operation order using Fenwick point increases in cast counts and range sums for queries. No query modifies the minion set; duplicates cannot alter earliest times. Stops at first bin never populated. Empty board still casts once, matching published example. Offline input processing computes requested answers from prior events only, not future minion insertions.
